name: Pareekshit Sachan
desc: Pareekshit Sachan is an Electrical Engineering master’s student at the University of Cape Town, with a strong interest in wireless communications, software-defined networking, and intelligent vehicular systems. His current research focuses on intent-driven network slicing and conflict-aware resource management for software-defined vehicles in 5G and beyond networks. His interests include telecommunications, software-defined radio, embedded systems, IoT, network experimentation, and the development of intelligent connected systems.
